confidence_notes: Food and drink estimates use a Thailand-wide cost-of-living index cross-checked against Pai price guides. Cocktail and wine estimates use Pai nightlife-guide price bands; wine prices are less certain. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for July and is the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used Pai-specific food and nightlife guides, with Thailand-wide cost-of-living data as a restaurant-price cross-check; no comparable city substitution.
